# What this notebook does

It writes every number the Afrobarometer Explorer shows. The website does no
statistics of its own beyond what its methodology note documents: re-basing
percentages from the valid to the asked denominator, summing the answers a
user selects, averaging country estimates into regional lines (and placing them
at the median fieldwork year of the set's countries), and turning a correlation
and its N into a p-value.

| Output (in `public/data/`) | Content |
|---|---|
| `manifest.json` | survey, rounds, countries (N and fieldwork year per round), subgroups, country sets |
| `index.json` | the harmonised battery: type, rounds asked, default indicator, source variables, trend breaks |
| `rounds/<round>.json` | every question in that round's file (scope B): type, default indicator, matching battery item |
| `v/<id>.json` | all respondents: weighted distributions, means, SEs and N by country-round (battery: every round; round-file question `R7_Q28`: its round) |
| `g/<round>/<id>.json` | the same by subgroup (gender, age, education, urban/rural), loaded on demand |
| `r/<round>/index.json`, `r/<round>/<id>.json` | within-country correlations of `<id>` with every battery item in that round |

It follows `AB_Trend_Analysis_Instructions.md` (in `Data Cleaning/`): the merged
file for every battery number; always weighted with the EA weight `weight`;
both denominators (valid by default, asked = AB's published style); fixed
country sets with each country counting equally; the hybrid time axis; declared
breaks never bridged; shares, not means, for short scales and the R10 statement
items. The core helpers (`ab_cy_share()`, `ab_cy_mean()`, `ab_region()`) come
from `AB_functions.R`, sourced from the data folder, and every check below
compares the site's numbers against them.

Every check is a `stopifnot()`, so **a knit that finishes means every check passed.**
Output is written to a staging folder and replaces `public/data` only at the end.

**To rebuild** (R 4.3.3, haven 2.5.4, data.table 1.14.10, jsonlite 1.8.8):

```r
Sys.setenv(AB_DATA_DIR = "~/Desktop/Larry RA/Afrobarometer Data")
rmarkdown::render("build_site_data.Rmd")     # from inside pipeline/
```

Then run the independent Python re-check and the browser-code check:

```sh
AB_DATA_DIR=".../Afrobarometer Data" python3 pipeline/verify_site_data.py 600
node pipeline/check_regions.mjs
```

```{r packages}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(haven); library(readxl); library(dplyr); library(tidyr)

})
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
PIPELINE_DIR <- normalizePath(".")
for (f in sort(list.files("R", pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE))) source(f, encoding = "UTF-8")
```

# The merged file

Read once with `user_na = TRUE`, so every negative code is kept and classified
by code (−1 / −2 / −5 nonresponse, −3 / −4 not asked), exactly as `ab_cy_share()`.

```{r read}
raw <- read_sav(MERGE_FILE, user_na = TRUE)
stopifnot(nrow(raw) == 402776, ncol(raw) == 109)
var_label  <- vapply(raw, function(x) attr(x, "label", exact = TRUE) %||% NA_character_, "")
val_labels <- lapply(raw, function(x) attr(x, "labels", exact = TRUE))
ab <- as.data.table(lapply(raw[setdiff(names(raw), "date_interview")], function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) return(x)
  v <- as.double(vctrs::vec_data(x))
  if (all(is.na(v) | (v == round(v) & abs(v) < 2e9))) as.integer(v) else v
}))
rm(raw); invisible(gc())
stopifnot(!anyNA(ab$weight), all(ab$weight > 0), all(ab$round %in% ROUNDS), all(ab$iso3 %in% countries$iso3))

# N, fieldwork year and mean weight per country-round equal AB_HarmonizedMerge_v1_country_round.csv
cr_n <- ab[, .(n = .N, year = unique(year), wmean = round(mean(weight), 4)), by = .(round, iso3)]
cmp <- merge(cr_n, as.data.table(cr_ref), by = c("round", "iso3"), all = TRUE)
stopifnot(!anyNA(cmp$n.x), !anyNA(cmp$n.y), all(cmp$n.x == cmp$n.y), all(cmp$year.x == cmp$year.y),
          max(abs(cmp$wmean - cmp$mean_weight)) < 1e-9, nrow(cmp) == 281)
# no country has two rounds in the same calendar year (the hybrid axis needs this)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(cr_n[, paste(iso3, year)]))
if (length(BUILD_ROUNDS)) ab <- ab[round %in% UNITS]
ab[, key := paste0(round, "_", iso3)]
wt <- ab$weight
cat(nrow(ab), "respondents,", length(UNITS), "rounds,", uniqueN(ab$key), "country-rounds\n")
```

# Subgroups

```{r subgroups}
build_memberships <- function(demo) {
  out <- list(data.table(row = seq_len(nrow(demo)), grp = "all"))
  for (s in SUBGROUPS) {
    v <- demo[[s$source]]
    for (g in s$groups) {
      hit <- if (!is.null(g$codes)) v %in% g$codes else !is.na(v) & v >= g$range[1] & v <= g$range[2]
      out[[length(out) + 1]] <- data.table(row = which(hit), grp = g$id)
    }
  }
  m <- rbindlist(out)
  m[, grp := factor(grp, levels = GROUP_IDS)]
  setkey(m, row)
  m
}
memb <- build_memberships(ab)
memb[, .N, by = grp]
for (s in SUBGROUPS) {                       # each respondent is in at most one group per dimension
  ids <- vapply(s$groups, `[[`, "", "id")
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(memb[grp %in% ids, row]))
}
# every subgroup source is available in every round (no subgroup has a start round)
stopifnot(all(vapply(SUBGROUPS, function(s) all(tapply(ab[[s$source]] >= 0, ab$round, any)), logical(1))))
```

# Catalogue: the harmonised battery

Code classes by code (see `R/10_catalogue.R`); types from the variable catalog.

```{r catalogue}
hvars <- catalog$variable
stopifnot(length(hvars) == 98, setequal(hvars, setdiff(names(ab), c(ADMIN_VARS, "key"))))
offscale_of <- function(v) { o <- catalog$offscale_codes[catalog$variable == v]; if (is.na(o)) numeric() else as.numeric(strsplit(o, ";")[[1]]) }
range_of <- function(v) { r <- catalog$valid_range[catalog$variable == v]; if (is.na(r)) NULL else as.numeric(strsplit(r, ":")[[1]]) }
hct <- list(); hcat <- list()
for (v in hvars) {
  ct <- harm_code_table(val_labels[[v]], ab[[v]], offscale_of(v))
  # every observed positive code is on the scale or a declared off-scale code (the merge's check, repeated)
  rg <- range_of(v); pos <- ct$code[ct$observed & ct$code >= 0]
  if (!is.null(rg)) stopifnot(all((pos >= rg[1] & pos <= rg[2]) | pos %in% offscale_of(v)))
  hct[[v]] <- ct
  hcat[[v]] <- tibble(variable = v, label = catalog$label[catalog$variable == v], type = catalog$type[catalog$variable == v],
                      n_scale = sum(ct$class == "substantive" & ct$observed),
                      offscale = paste(sprintf("%g=%s", ct$code[ct$class == "offscale"], ct$label[ct$class == "offscale"]), collapse = "; "))
}
hcat <- bind_rows(hcat)
hcat |> count(type)
# source variable and approved judgement call per round, from the crosswalk
src_of <- split(rr, rr$harm_var)
```

# Estimates: the harmonised battery, one file per question, all rounds

For every question: weighted % of valid answers per code, nonresponse % of the
asked, unweighted counts, Kish effective N, and (for interval-like items only)
mean / SD / SE, for every country-round × group. All-respondent cells go in
`v/<var>.json`; subgroup cells in `g/<round>/<var>.json`.

```{r estimates-helpers}
unit_of <- function(k) as.integer(sub("_.*$", "", k))
cc_of   <- function(k) sub("^\\d+_", "", k)
# All-respondent cells keep percentages to 2 decimals (so regional and benchmark averages of the
# published cells match the merge to ~0.001). Subgroup cells are slimmed to what the views use:
# percentages to 1 decimal, no per-code counts or SD, Kish N to the integer.
# (estimate_cells() returns unrounded percentages; each cell is rounded once, here.)
round_cell <- function(cell, d) {
  if (!is.null(cell$p)) cell$p <- arr(round(unlist(cell$p), d))
  if (!is.null(cell$q)) cell$q <- arr(round(unlist(cell$q), d))
  cell
}
slim <- function(cell) {
  cell$c <- NULL; cell$sd <- NULL
  if (!is.null(cell$ne)) cell$ne <- round(cell$ne)
  round_cell(cell, 1)
}
nest_cy <- function(est, groups) {
  out <- list()
  for (k in names(est)) {
    cell <- est[[k]][intersect(groups, names(est[[k]]))]
    if (!identical(groups, "all")) cell <- lapply(cell, slim)
    if (!length(cell)) next
    u <- as.character(unit_of(k)); cc <- cc_of(k)
    if (is.null(out[[u]])) out[[u]] <- list()
    out[[u]][[cc]] <- if (identical(groups, "all")) round_cell(cell$all, 2) else cell
  }
  out[order(as.integer(names(out)))] |> lapply(function(z) z[order(names(z))])
}
sub_groups <- setdiff(GROUP_IDS, "all")
file_sizes <- list(); all_nr <- list()
log_size <- function(kind, id, unit, bytes) file_sizes[[length(file_sizes) + 1]] <<- tibble(kind = kind, id = id, unit = unit, bytes = bytes)

# Shared by the battery and the round files. x: codes for the rows in `rows_all`
# (a subset of ab), ct: code table, ty: type. Returns the record, the index entry pieces
# and the meta used by the checks.
estimate_question <- function(id, x_in, ct, ty, keys, w, m_rows, rows_note = NULL, nr_note_id = id, offscale_extra = NULL) {
  xv <- as.numeric(x_in)
  cls <- ct$class[match(xv, ct$code)]
  cls[is.na(xv)] <- "not_asked"
  stopifnot(!anyNA(cls))
  nr_raw <- sort(unique(xv[cls == "nonresponse"]))
  x <- xv; x[cls == "nonresponse"] <- -1
  obs_sub <- ct$code[ct$class == "substantive" & ct$observed]
  sub <- ct |> filter(class %in% c("substantive", "offscale"),
                      observed | (ty != "nominal" & !is.na(label) & class == "substantive" & code >= min(obs_sub) & code <= max(obs_sub))) |>
    arrange(class != "substantive", code)
  stopifnot(!any(sub$code == -1 & sub$class == "substantive"))
  scale_codes <- if (ty == "continuous") numeric() else sub$code[sub$class == "substantive"]
  mean_ok <- mean_allowed(ty, scale_codes)
  if (ty == "continuous") {
    bins <- make_bins(xv[cls == "substantive"])
    xbin <- bin_index(xv, bins)
    codes <- seq_along(bins$labels); labels <- bins$labels
  } else {
    xbin <- NULL; codes <- sub$code
    labels <- ifelse(is.na(sub$label), format(sub$code, trim = TRUE), sub$label)
  }
  sparse <- ty == "nominal" && length(codes) > 25
  keep <- cls %in% c("substantive", "offscale", "nonresponse")
  m_v <- m_rows[keep[row]]
  est <- estimate_cells(x, cls, codes, if (length(nr_raw)) -1 else numeric(), keys, w, m_v, mean_ok, xbin, sparse, digits = 12)
  # A country-round in which every answer is nonresponse is a question not really asked there
  # (e.g. the whole of R2 country 12 is system-missing on 30 items, coded -5 in the merge): not published.
  nr_only <- names(est)[vapply(est, function(e) (e$all$nv %||% 0) == 0, logical(1))]
  if (length(nr_only)) all_nr[[length(all_nr) + 1]] <<- tibble(id = nr_note_id, round = unit_of(nr_only), iso3 = cc_of(nr_only),
                                                               n = vapply(est[nr_only], function(e) e$all$n, 0))
  est <- est[!names(est) %in% nr_only]
  if (!length(est)) return(NULL)
  est_all <- nest_cy(est, "all"); est_grp <- nest_cy(est, sub_groups)
  rec <- list(id = id, type = ty, codes = arr(codes), labels = arr(labels),
              nr = arr(if (length(nr_raw)) -1 else numeric()), nr_labels = arr(if (length(nr_raw)) NR_LABEL else character()),
              nr_raw = arr(nr_raw), sparse = sparse, units = arr(as.integer(names(est_all))))
  if (ty != "continuous" && any(sub$class == "offscale")) rec$offscale <- arr(sub$code[sub$class == "offscale"])
  if (ty == "continuous") rec$range <- arr(range(xv[cls == "substantive"], na.rm = TRUE))
  if (ty == "nominal") {            # the answer list offered (observed) each round: trends compare within lists
    ok <- cls %in% c("substantive", "offscale")
    rec$yc <- lapply(split(xv[ok], unit_of(keys[ok])), function(z) arr(sort(unique(z))))
  }
  list(rec = rec, est_all = est_all, est_grp = est_grp, codes = codes, sub = sub, scale = scale_codes,
       mean_ok = mean_ok, nr_raw = nr_raw, sparse = sparse)
}

# nominal default: the most common answer in the latest round (mean over countries)
nominal_default <- function(est_all, codes) {
  last <- est_all[[length(est_all)]]; tot <- list()
  for (cell in last) { kk <- if (!is.null(cell$k)) cell$k else codes
    for (i in seq_along(kk)) tot[[as.character(kk[i])]] <- (tot[[as.character(kk[i])]] %||% 0) + cell$p[i] }
  list(type = "share", codes = arr(as.numeric(names(which.max(unlist(tot))))))
}

write_question <- function(q, extra = list()) {
  extra <- Filter(Negate(is.null), extra)
  rec <- c(q$rec, extra); rec$est <- q$est_all
  log_size("v", rec$id, NA, write_json_compact(rec, file.path(OUT_DIR, "v", paste0(rec$id, ".json"))))
  for (u in names(q$est_grp))
    log_size("g", rec$id, as.integer(u), write_json_compact(list(id = rec$id, round = as.integer(u), est = q$est_grp[[u]]),
                                                           file.path(OUT_DIR, "g", u, paste0(rec$id, ".json"))))
}
ends_of <- function(q, ty) {
  if (!ty %in% c("ordinal", "binary")) return(NULL)
  s <- q$sub[q$sub$class == "substantive", ]
  arr(c(sprintf("%g = %s", s$code[1], s$label[1]), sprintf("%g = %s", s$code[nrow(s)], s$label[nrow(s)])))
}
```

```{r estimates-battery}
index_vars <- list(); var_meta <- list()
t0 <- Sys.time()
for (v in hvars) {
  ty <- catalog$type[catalog$variable == v]
  q <- estimate_question(v, ab[[v]], hct[[v]], ty, ab$key, wt, memb)
  if (is.null(q)) { stopifnot(length(BUILD_ROUNDS) > 0); next }     # a subset build without this item's rounds
  ind <- default_indicator(v, ty, q$scale, trend_ind)
  brk <- trend_breaks(v, trend_brk)
  rx <- (src_of[[v]] %||% rr[0, ]) |> arrange(round) |> filter(round %in% UNITS)
  src <- setNames(as.list(rx$source_var), rx$round)
  jc <- rx |> filter(review == "approved", !is.na(note))
  extra <- list(src = src, wording = catalog$wording[catalog$variable == v])
  if (nrow(jc)) extra$jc <- setNames(as.list(jc$note), jc$round)
  write_question(q, extra)
  entry <- list(id = v, q = catalog$label[catalog$variable == v], s = catalog$domain[catalog$variable == v], t = ty,
                k = length(q$codes), u = q$rec$units, d = ind, m = q$mean_ok)
  e <- ends_of(q, ty); if (!is.null(e)) entry$ends <- e
  note <- catalog$comparability_note[catalog$variable == v]
  if (!is.na(note)) entry$note <- note
  if (!is.null(brk)) entry$tb <- brk
  if (trend_ind$featured[trend_ind$variable == v] == "1") entry$f <- 1L
  if (nzchar(trend_ind$default_set[trend_ind$variable == v])) entry$ds <- trend_ind$default_set[trend_ind$variable == v]
  index_vars[[length(index_vars) + 1]] <- entry
  var_meta[[v]] <- list(type = ty, codes = q$codes, scale = q$scale, nr_raw = q$nr_raw, units = q$rec$units,
                        sparse = q$sparse, mean_ok = q$mean_ok, offscale = q$rec$offscale %||% numeric())
}
cat(length(index_vars), "battery questions written in", format(Sys.time() - t0), "\n")
```

# Round files: every question in every round (scope B)

Each round file is read with raw codes (`user_na = TRUE`; string columns, which are
open-ended text, are not read). Rows line up one-to-one with the merge's rows for that
round (checked on respondent number, country and weight), so every question gets the
same weights, countries and subgroups as the battery. Response codes are classified by
the crosswalk where the variable feeds the battery, else by label (`R/10_catalogue.R`).

```{r round-files}
round_index <- list(); round_meta <- list(); round_review <- list(); round_codes_review <- list()
corr_store <- list(); xw_vs_label <- list()
harm_off <- setNames(lapply(hvars, offscale_of), hvars)
read_round <- function(r) {
  f <- ROUND_FILE(r)
  h <- read_sav(f, n_max = 0, user_na = TRUE)
  num <- names(h)[!vapply(h, is.character, TRUE)]
  idv <- rf$id_var[rf$round == r]
  junk <- capture.output(x <- read_sav(f, user_na = TRUE, col_select = all_of(num)), type = "message")
  id <- read_sav(f, col_select = all_of(idv))[[1]]      # read alone: R6 has undecodable bytes in other text columns
  attr(x, "id") <- id
  list(x = x, strings = setdiff(names(h), num), string_labels = vapply(h[setdiff(names(h), num)], function(z) attr(z, "label", exact = TRUE) %||% NA_character_, ""))
}
if (!SKIP_ROUND_FILES) for (r in UNITS) {
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  rd <- read_round(r); x <- rd$x
  fr <- rf[rf$round == r, ]
  rows <- which(ab$round == r)
  stopifnot(nrow(x) == fr$n, length(rows) == fr$n)
  # row alignment with the merge: respondent number, country (by the crosswalk's code map) and weight
  idv <- if (fr$id_var == "refnumb") sprintf("%05d", as.integer(vctrs::vec_data(x[[fr$id_var]]))) else trimws(as.character(attr(x, "id")))
  ccode <- as.numeric(vctrs::vec_data(x[[fr$country_var]]))
  cov <- cc_sheet[cc_sheet$round == r, ]
  stopifnot(identical(idv, ab$respno[rows]),
            identical(cov$iso3[match(ccode, cov$source_country_code)], ab$iso3[rows]),
            isTRUE(all.equal(as.numeric(vctrs::vec_data(x[[fr$weight_var]])), ab$weight[rows], tolerance = 0)))
  keys_r <- ab$key[rows]; w_r <- wt[rows]
  memb_r <- memb[J(rows), nomatch = 0L][, .(row = match(row, rows), grp)]; setkey(memb_r, row)
  rules_r <- rr[rr$round == r, ]
  # string columns: open-ended text, not shown
  round_review[[length(round_review) + 1]] <- tibble(round = r, variable = rd$strings, label = rd$string_labels, status = "text (not shown)",
                                                     type = NA_character_, reason = "string variable", section = NA_character_, harmonised = NA_character_)
  X <- list(); entries <- list()
  for (v in names(x)) {
    col <- x[[v]]
    lab <- attr(col, "label", exact = TRUE) %||% NA_character_
    rv <- function(status, type = NA_character_, reason = NA_character_, section = NA_character_, harm = NA_character_)
      round_review[[length(round_review) + 1]] <<- tibble(round = r, variable = v, label = lab, status = status, type = type,
                                                          reason = reason, section = section, harmonised = harm)
    if (inherits(col, c("Date", "POSIXct", "hms"))) { rv("admin (date/time)"); next }
    if (round_is_admin(v, lab)) { rv("admin (not shown)"); next }
    xv <- as.numeric(vctrs::vec_data(col))
    m <- rules_r[rules_r$source_var == v, ]
    xr <- NULL; harm <- character()
    if (nrow(m)) {
      harm <- m$harm_var
      xr <- list(missing = ab_parse_map(m$missing[1]), recode = ab_parse_map(m$recode[1]), copy = ab_parse_copy(m$recode[1]),
                 off = unlist(harm_off[harm]))
      # a source variable used by two battery items (education/education4) must give the same classes
      if (nrow(m) > 1) for (j in 2:nrow(m)) {
        xr2 <- list(missing = ab_parse_map(m$missing[j]), recode = ab_parse_map(m$recode[j]), copy = ab_parse_copy(m$recode[j]), off = xr$off)
        cds <- sort(unique(xv[!is.na(xv)])); stopifnot(identical(xw_class(cds, xr), xw_class(cds, xr2)))
      }
    }
    ct <- round_code_table(attr(col, "labels", exact = TRUE), xv, xr, lab)
    if (!is.null(xr)) {               # how far the label rules agree with the reviewed crosswalk classes
      lc <- round_code_table(attr(col, "labels", exact = TRUE), xv, NULL, lab)
      xwc <- xw_class(ct$code, xr)
      j <- inner_join(ct |> mutate(xw = xwc) |> filter(observed) |> select(code, label, xw), lc |> select(code, lab_rule = class), by = "code")
      j$n <- as.vector(table(factor(xv, levels = j$code)))
      xw_vs_label[[length(xw_vs_label) + 1]] <- j |> mutate(round = r, variable = v)
    }
    ov <- overrides[overrides$round == as.character(r) & overrides$variable == v, ]
    t <- var_type_one(v, lab, xv, ct)
    # a variable feeding a nominal battery item (support for democracy's three statements, gender,
    # urban/rural) is nominal too, whatever its codes look like
    if (length(harm) && any(catalog$type[match(harm, catalog$variable)] == "nominal") && t$type != "empty")
      t <- list(type = "nominal", reason = paste("as battery item", paste(harm, collapse = "/")))
    if (nrow(ov)) t <- list(type = ov$type[1], reason = paste("override:", ov$note[1]))
    sec <- round_section(v, lab, if (length(harm)) catalog$domain[match(harm[1], catalog$variable)] else NA_character_)
    if (t$type %in% c("empty", "exclude")) { rv(paste0(t$type, " (not shown)"), t$type, t$reason, sec, paste(harm, collapse = ";")); next }
    id <- paste0("R", r, "_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", v))
    q <- estimate_question(id, xv, ct, t$type, keys_r, w_r, memb_r)
    if (is.null(q)) { rv("no valid answers (not shown)", t$type, t$reason, sec, paste(harm, collapse = ";")); next }
    ind <- default_indicator(id, t$type, q$scale) %||% nominal_default(q$est_all, q$codes)
    qt <- round_question_text(lab, v)
    write_question(q, list(code = v, label = lab, round = r, h = if (length(harm)) arr(harm) else NULL))
    entry <- list(id = id, code = v, q = qt, s = sec, t = t$type, k = length(q$codes), d = ind, m = q$mean_ok)
    e <- ends_of(q, t$type); if (!is.null(e)) entry$ends <- e
    if (length(harm)) entry$h <- arr(harm)
    entries[[length(entries) + 1]] <- entry
    rv("shown", t$type, t$reason, sec, paste(harm, collapse = ";"))
    round_codes_review[[length(round_codes_review) + 1]] <- ct |> mutate(round = r, variable = v, id = id, type = t$type) |>
      select(round, variable, id, type, code, label, observed, class, rule)
    round_meta[[id]] <- list(round = r, var = v, type = t$type, codes = q$codes, scale = q$scale, nr_raw = q$nr_raw, sparse = q$sparse,
                             mean_ok = q$mean_ok, offscale = q$rec$offscale %||% numeric(), harm = harm, ct = ct)
    if (t$type %in% c("ordinal", "binary", "continuous")) {
      z <- xv; cl <- ct$class[match(z, ct$code)]; z[is.na(cl) | cl != "substantive"] <- NA
      X[[id]] <- z
    }
  }
  ids_r <- vapply(entries, `[[`, "", "id")
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(tolower(ids_r)))
  round_index[[as.character(r)]] <- entries
  corr_store[[as.character(r)]] <- list(X = if (length(X)) do.call(cbind, X) else NULL)
  rm(x, rd, X); invisible(gc())
  cat(sprintf("R%d: %d questions shown, %d correlatable (%s)\n", r, length(entries), ncol(corr_store[[as.character(r)]]$X %||% matrix(nrow = 0, ncol = 0)),
              format(Sys.time() - t0)))
}
round_review <- bind_rows(round_review)
if (nrow(round_review)) {
  write.csv(round_review, file.path(REVIEW_DIR, "round_catalogue_review.csv"), row.names = FALSE, na = "")
  write.csv(bind_rows(round_codes_review), file.path(REVIEW_DIR, "round_code_review.csv"), row.names = FALSE, na = "")
  round_review |> count(round, status) |> pivot_wider(names_from = status, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
}
```

How often the label rules would have put a respondent in the same base (valid answer /
nonresponse / not asked) as the reviewed crosswalk, for the variables the crosswalk covers:
a test of the rules used for every other question. (On-scale vs off-scale differs by design:
the crosswalk's off-scale codes are off the *battery's* scale.)

```{r label-rules-vs-crosswalk}
if (length(xw_vs_label)) {
  base_of <- function(cl) ifelse(cl %in% c("substantive", "offscale"), "valid", cl)
  xl <- bind_rows(xw_vs_label) |> mutate(same_base = base_of(xw) == base_of(lab_rule))
  agree <- xl |> summarise(codes = n(), codes_same_base = mean(same_base), respondents = sum(n), resp_same_base = sum(n[same_base]) / sum(n))
  print(agree)
  dis <- xl |> filter(xw != lab_rule) |> count(label, xw, lab_rule, same_base, wt = n, name = "respondents", sort = TRUE)
  write.csv(dis, file.path(REVIEW_DIR, "label_rules_vs_crosswalk.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  head(dis, 25)
  stopifnot(agree$resp_same_base > 0.999)
}
```

# Correlations, one round at a time

Weighted pairwise Pearson r within each country-round, on substantive (on-scale) codes
only, with pairwise deletion and at least `r MIN_PAIR_N` respondents. Battery items:
every pair of ordered, yes/no or numeric battery items asked that round. Round-file
questions: each against every battery item that round (decision 2026-10-08). Nominal
questions are never correlated.

```{r correlations}
corr_cols <- list(); corr_check <- list()
set.seed(20261008)
for (r in UNITS) {
  rows <- which(ab$round == r)
  bv <- names(var_meta)[vapply(names(var_meta), function(v) var_meta[[v]]$type %in% c("ordinal", "binary", "continuous") &&
                                                       r %in% var_meta[[v]]$units, logical(1))]
  Y <- do.call(cbind, lapply(bv, function(v) {
    z <- as.numeric(ab[[v]][rows]); cl <- hct[[v]]$class[match(z, hct[[v]]$code)]; z[is.na(cl) | cl != "substantive"] <- NA; z }))
  colnames(Y) <- bv
  cty <- ab$iso3[rows]; w_r <- wt[rows]
  by_c <- split(seq_along(rows), cty)
  res <- lapply(by_c, function(i) weighted_pairwise_cor(Y[i, , drop = FALSE], w_r[i]))
  keep_v <- Reduce(`|`, lapply(res, function(cc) diag(cc$n) >= MIN_PAIR_N))
  Y <- Y[, keep_v, drop = FALSE]; bv <- bv[keep_v]
  res <- lapply(res, function(cc) list(r = cc$r[keep_v, keep_v, drop = FALSE], n = cc$n[keep_v, keep_v, drop = FALSE]))
  write_corr <- function(id, rmat, nmat, j, n0) {
    keep <- names(rmat)[vapply(names(rmat), function(c) n0[[c]] >= MIN_PAIR_N, logical(1))]
    rr_ <- lapply(rmat[keep], function(m) arr(as.integer(round(1000 * m[j, ]))))
    dn  <- lapply(keep, function(c) arr(as.integer(n0[[c]] - nmat[[c]][j, ]))); names(dn) <- keep
    log_size("r", id, r, write_json_compact(list(id = id, round = r, r = rr_, n0 = n0[keep], dn = dn),
                                            file.path(OUT_DIR, "r", r, paste0(id, ".json"))))
  }
  for (j in seq_along(bv)) {
    n0 <- lapply(res, function(cc) as.integer(cc$n[j, j]))
    write_corr(bv[j], lapply(res, `[[`, "r"), lapply(res, `[[`, "n"), j, n0)
  }
  # checks against cov.wt: 25 random battery pairs
  for (k in 1:25) {
    c1 <- sample(names(res), 1); i <- by_c[[c1]]; jj <- sample(length(bv), 2)
    ref <- suppressWarnings(tryCatch(cor_reference(Y[i, jj[1]], Y[i, jj[2]], w_r[i]), error = function(e) NA))
    corr_check[[length(corr_check) + 1]] <- tibble(round = r, kind = "battery", country = c1, a = bv[jj[1]], b = bv[jj[2]],
                                                   mine = res[[c1]]$r[jj[1], jj[2]], ref = ref)
  }
  items <- character()
  Xr <- corr_store[[as.character(r)]]$X
  if (!is.null(Xr)) {
    resx <- lapply(by_c, function(i) weighted_cross_cor(Xr[i, , drop = FALSE], Y[i, , drop = FALSE], w_r[i]))
    nx <- lapply(by_c, function(i) colSums(!is.na(Xr[i, , drop = FALSE])))
    for (j in seq_len(ncol(Xr))) {
      n0 <- lapply(nx, function(z) as.integer(z[j]))
      if (!any(unlist(n0) >= MIN_PAIR_N)) next
      write_corr(colnames(Xr)[j], lapply(resx, `[[`, "r"), lapply(resx, `[[`, "n"), j, n0)
      items <- c(items, colnames(Xr)[j])
    }
    for (k in 1:25) {
      c1 <- sample(names(resx), 1); i <- by_c[[c1]]; a <- sample(ncol(Xr), 1); b <- sample(ncol(Y), 1)
      ref <- suppressWarnings(tryCatch(cor_reference(Xr[i, a], Y[i, b], w_r[i]), error = function(e) NA))
      corr_check[[length(corr_check) + 1]] <- tibble(round = r, kind = "round x battery", country = c1, a = colnames(Xr)[a], b = bv[b],
                                                     mine = resx[[c1]]$r[a, b], ref = ref)
    }
  }
  write_json_compact(list(round = r, corr = arr(bv), items = arr(items)), file.path(OUT_DIR, "r", r, "index.json"))
  corr_cols[[as.character(r)]] <- list(battery = bv, items = items)
  cat(sprintf("R%d: %d battery items, %d round-file questions correlated\n", r, length(bv), length(items)))
}
rm(corr_store); invisible(gc())
corr_check <- bind_rows(corr_check)
```

# Checks

## Every cell adds up, and no cell exceeds its country-round

Percentages over valid respondents sum to 100 (within rounding), unweighted counts sum
to the valid N, nonresponse shares lie in 0–100, means lie on the scale, no subgroup
exceeds its country, and no cell has more respondents than its country-round has in
`AB_HarmonizedMerge_v1_country_round.csv`. For every file: battery and round-file questions.

```{r check-cells}
N_cr <- setNames(cr_ref$n, paste(cr_ref$round, cr_ref$iso3))
check_cell <- function(e, rec, tag) {
  bad <- character()
  if (e$nv > 0) {
    p <- unlist(e$p); cnt <- unlist(e$c)
    if (abs(sum(p) - 100) > 0.05 * length(p) + 0.1) bad <- c(bad, paste(tag, "p-sum", sum(p)))
    if (!is.null(e$c) && sum(cnt) != e$nv) bad <- c(bad, paste(tag, "count-sum"))
    if (!is.null(e$m)) {
      lo <- if (rec$type == "continuous") unlist(rec$range)[1] else min(unlist(rec$codes))
      hi <- if (rec$type == "continuous") unlist(rec$range)[2] else max(unlist(rec$codes))
      if (e$m < lo - 1e-9 || e$m > hi + 1e-9) bad <- c(bad, paste(tag, "mean-range"))
    }
  }
  if (!is.null(e$q)) { q <- unlist(e$q); if (any(q < 0 | q > 100) || sum(q) > 100.1) bad <- c(bad, paste(tag, "q")) }
  if (e$n < e$nv) bad <- c(bad, paste(tag, "n<nv"))
  bad
}
problems <- character(); n_cells <- 0
for (id in c(names(var_meta), names(round_meta))) {
  rec <- fromJSON(file.path(OUT_DIR, "v", paste0(id, ".json")), simplifyVector = FALSE)
  for (u in names(rec$est)) {
    gf <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "g", u, paste0(id, ".json"))
    grp <- if (file.exists(gf)) fromJSON(gf, simplifyVector = FALSE)$est else list()
    for (cc in names(rec$est[[u]])) {
      e <- rec$est[[u]][[cc]]; n_cells <- n_cells + 1
      problems <- c(problems, check_cell(e, rec, paste(id, u, cc, "all")))
      if (is.null(N_cr[paste(u, cc)]) || is.na(N_cr[paste(u, cc)]) || e$n > N_cr[[paste(u, cc)]]) problems <- c(problems, paste(id, u, cc, "n > country-round N"))
      for (g in names(grp[[cc]])) {
        eg <- grp[[cc]][[g]]; n_cells <- n_cells + 1
        problems <- c(problems, check_cell(eg, rec, paste(id, u, cc, g)))
        if (eg$n > e$n) problems <- c(problems, paste(id, u, cc, g, "group n > all n"))
      }
    }
  }
}
cat(n_cells, "cells checked;", length(problems), "problems\n"); head(problems)
stopifnot(length(problems) == 0)
```

## Rounds and coverage

Each battery question's rounds equal the catalog's `rounds`; the countries published in
each round equal the countries the catalog counts as asked (less any country-round in
which every answer was nonresponse); every cell is a surveyed country-round; no round
outside 1–10, so nothing is interpolated. Round-file questions: every cell is a
surveyed country-round of that round.

```{r check-coverage}
all_nr <- bind_rows(all_nr)
if (!nrow(all_nr)) all_nr <- tibble(id = character(), round = integer(), iso3 = character(), n = numeric())
write.csv(all_nr, file.path(REVIEW_DIR, "nonresponse_only_country_rounds.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat(nrow(all_nr), "country-rounds left out because every answer was nonresponse:\n")
all_nr |> filter(!grepl("^R\\d+_", id)) |> count(id, round, name = "countries")
cat_rounds <- setNames(lapply(strsplit(catalog$rounds, ";"), as.integer), catalog$variable)
cat_cpr <- setNames(lapply(strsplit(catalog$countries_per_round, "; "), function(z)
  setNames(as.integer(sub("^R\\d+:", "", z)), as.integer(sub("^R(\\d+):.*$", "\\1", z)))), catalog$variable)
surveyed <- paste(cr_ref$round, cr_ref$iso3)
cov_bad <- character()
for (v in names(var_meta)) {
  rec <- fromJSON(file.path(OUT_DIR, "v", paste0(v, ".json")), simplifyVector = FALSE)
  if (!setequal(as.integer(names(rec$est)), intersect(cat_rounds[[v]], UNITS))) cov_bad <- c(cov_bad, paste(v, "rounds"))
  valid_c <- ab[get(v) >= 0, .(c = list(sort(unique(iso3)))), by = round]
  for (u in names(rec$est)) {
    pub <- sort(names(rec$est[[u]]))
    # published = countries with at least one valid answer; at most the countries the catalog counts as asked
    if (!identical(pub, valid_c$c[[match(as.integer(u), valid_c$round)]])) cov_bad <- c(cov_bad, paste(v, u, "countries"))
    if (length(pub) > cat_cpr[[v]][[u]]) cov_bad <- c(cov_bad, paste(v, u, "more than the catalog"))
    if (!all(paste(u, pub) %in% surveyed)) cov_bad <- c(cov_bad, paste(v, u, "unsurveyed"))
  }
}
for (id in names(round_meta)) {
  rec <- fromJSON(file.path(OUT_DIR, "v", paste0(id, ".json")), simplifyVector = FALSE)
  if (!identical(names(rec$est), as.character(round_meta[[id]]$round))) cov_bad <- c(cov_bad, paste(id, "round"))
  if (!all(paste(names(rec$est), names(rec$est[[1]])) %in% surveyed)) cov_bad <- c(cov_bad, paste(id, "unsurveyed"))
}
cov_bad
man <- fromJSON(file.path(OUT_DIR, "manifest.json"), simplifyVector = FALSE)
stopifnot(length(cov_bad) == 0, length(man$countries) == if (length(BUILD_ROUNDS)) length(unique(cr_build$iso3)) else 45,
          all(vapply(man$waves, function(w) w$id %in% ROUNDS, logical(1))))
cat("Coverage OK:", length(var_meta), "battery questions,", length(round_meta), "round-file questions\n")
```

## Round-file questions agree with the battery items they feed

For every round-file variable the crosswalk maps into the battery, the published
country cells must give the same asked and valid N as the battery item, and the same
weighted shares once the source codes are mapped by the crosswalk's recode.

```{r check-round-vs-battery}
rvb <- list()
for (id in names(round_meta)) {
  m <- round_meta[[id]]
  if (!length(m$harm)) next
  rec <- fromJSON(file.path(OUT_DIR, "v", paste0(id, ".json")), simplifyVector = FALSE)
  u <- as.character(m$round)
  for (h in m$harm) {
    if (var_meta[[h]]$type == "continuous" || m$type == "continuous") next
    hrec <- fromJSON(file.path(OUT_DIR, "v", paste0(h, ".json")), simplifyVector = FALSE)
    rule <- rr[rr$round == m$round & rr$harm_var == h, ]
    rmap <- ab_parse_map(rule$recode)
    for (cc in names(rec$est[[u]])) {
      a <- rec$est[[u]][[cc]]; b <- hrec$est[[u]][[cc]]
      if (is.null(b)) { rvb[[length(rvb) + 1]] <- tibble(id = id, h = h, cc = cc, bad = "missing in battery", d = NA); next }
      d <- 0
      if (a$n != b$n || a$nv != b$nv) { rvb[[length(rvb) + 1]] <- tibble(id = id, h = h, cc = cc, bad = "N", d = NA); next }
      ka <- unlist(a$k %||% rec$codes); kb <- unlist(b$k %||% hrec$codes)
      for (hc in kb) {
        srcs <- as.numeric(names(rmap)[rmap == hc])
        pa <- sum(unlist(a$p)[ka %in% srcs]); pb <- unlist(b$p)[kb == hc]
        d <- max(d, abs(pa - pb) - 0.05 * max(1, length(srcs)))
      }
      rvb[[length(rvb) + 1]] <- tibble(id = id, h = h, cc = cc, bad = if (d > 1e-9) "share" else "", d = d)
    }
  }
}
rvb <- bind_rows(rvb)
if (nrow(rvb)) {
  print(rvb |> summarise(cells = n(), pairs = n_distinct(paste(id, h)), problems = sum(bad != "")))
  print(rvb |> filter(bad != "") |> head(10))
  shown_src <- vapply(round_meta, function(m) paste(m$round, m$var), "")
  no_item <- rr |> filter(round %in% UNITS, !paste(round, source_var) %in% shown_src)
  print(no_item |> select(harm_var, round, source_var))
  stopifnot(all(rvb$bad == ""), all(no_item$harm_var == "urban_rural"))
}
```

## Random cells against `ab_cy_share()` and `ab_cy_mean()`, both bases

`AB_functions.R`'s helpers recompute random country-round cells, for all respondents and
for subgroups (the helper run on the group's respondents), on both bases. Battery cells
come straight from the merge; round-file cells give the helpers the round file's codes
with this site's classes written as AB's negative codes (nonresponse −1, not asked −4),
so the check covers the arithmetic, and `round_code_review.csv` the classes. The
asked-base value is the browser's formula, `p × (1 − Σ nonresponse / 100)`.

```{r check-random}
set.seed(20261008)
site_share <- function(cell, rec, success, base) {
  kk <- unlist(cell$k %||% rec$codes); p <- sum(unlist(cell$p)[kk %in% success])
  if (base == "asked") p <- p * (1 - sum(unlist(cell$q %||% list(0))) / 100)
  p
}
group_rows <- function(g) if (g == "all") seq_len(nrow(ab)) else memb[grp == g, row]
helper_frame <- function(rows, x) tibble(round = ab$round[rows], iso3 = ab$iso3[rows], country = ab$country[rows],
                                         year = ab$year[rows], weight = ab$weight[rows], v = x)
round_codes_cache <- new.env()
round_x <- function(id) {          # the round file's codes for this question, with classes as negative codes
  if (!is.null(round_codes_cache[[id]])) return(round_codes_cache[[id]])
  m <- round_meta[[id]]
  junk <- capture.output(z <- read_sav(ROUND_FILE(m$round), user_na = TRUE, col_select = all_of(m$var)), type = "message")
  xv <- as.numeric(vctrs::vec_data(z[[1]])); cl <- m$ct$class[match(xv, m$ct$code)]; cl[is.na(xv)] <- "not_asked"
  xv[cl == "nonresponse"] <- -1; xv[cl == "not_asked"] <- -4
  round_codes_cache[[id]] <- xv
  xv
}
one_check <- function(id, kind) {
  m <- if (kind == "battery") var_meta[[id]] else round_meta[[id]]
  rec <- fromJSON(file.path(OUT_DIR, "v", paste0(id, ".json")), simplifyVector = FALSE)
  u <- sample(names(rec$est), 1); cc <- sample(names(rec$est[[u]]), 1)
  g <- "all"; cell <- rec$est[[u]][[cc]]
  if (runif(1) < 0.5) {
    gf <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "g", u, paste0(id, ".json"))
    ge <- if (file.exists(gf)) fromJSON(gf, simplifyVector = FALSE)$est[[cc]] else NULL
    if (length(ge)) { g <- sample(names(ge), 1); cell <- ge[[g]] }
  }
  if (cell$nv == 0) return(NULL)
  kk <- unlist(cell$k %||% rec$codes)
  success <- if (length(kk) > 1 && runif(1) < 0.5) sample(kk, 2) else sample(kk, 1)
  rows_u <- which(ab$round == as.integer(u) & ab$iso3 == cc)
  x_all <- if (kind == "battery") ab[[id]][rows_u] else round_x(id)[match(rows_u, which(ab$round == as.integer(u)))]
  keep <- rows_u %in% group_rows(g)
  hd <- helper_frame(rows_u[keep], x_all[keep])
  if (m$type == "continuous") {
    ref_m <- ab_cy_mean(hd, "v", range = range(hd$v[hd$v >= 0]))$mean
    return(tibble(id = id, kind = kind, round = u, iso3 = cc, group = g, k_codes = 0, d_valid = 0, d_asked = 0,
                  d_mean = if (is.null(cell$m)) 0 else abs(cell$m - ref_m), d_n = abs(cell$nv - sum(hd$v >= 0))))
  }
  ref_v <- ab_cy_share(hd, "v", success, base = "valid")$share
  ref_a <- ab_cy_share(hd, "v", success, base = "asked")$share
  ref_m <- if (!is.null(cell$m)) ab_cy_mean(hd, "v", range = m$scale)$mean else NA
  tibble(id = id, kind = kind, round = u, iso3 = cc, group = g, k_codes = length(success),
         d_valid = abs(site_share(cell, rec, success, "valid") - ref_v),
         d_asked = abs(site_share(cell, rec, success, "asked") - ref_a),
         d_mean  = if (is.na(ref_m)) 0 else abs(cell$m - ref_m),
         d_n = abs(cell$n - nrow(hd[hd$v >= 0 | hd$v %in% NR_CODES, ])))
}
round_sample <- if (length(round_meta)) sample(names(round_meta), 250, replace = TRUE) else character()
for (r in unique(vapply(round_sample, function(id) round_meta[[id]]$round, 0))) {   # one read per round file
  ids <- unique(round_sample[vapply(round_sample, function(id) round_meta[[id]]$round == r, TRUE)])
  junk <- capture.output(z <- read_sav(ROUND_FILE(r), user_na = TRUE, col_select = all_of(unique(vapply(ids, function(id) round_meta[[id]]$var, "")))), type = "message")
  for (id in ids) {
    m <- round_meta[[id]]
    xv <- as.numeric(vctrs::vec_data(z[[m$var]])); cl <- m$ct$class[match(xv, m$ct$code)]; cl[is.na(xv)] <- "not_asked"
    xv[cl == "nonresponse"] <- -1; xv[cl == "not_asked"] <- -4
    round_codes_cache[[id]] <- xv
  }
}
recheck <- bind_rows(
  map_dfr(1:450, function(k) one_check(sample(names(var_meta), 1), "battery")),
  map_dfr(round_sample, function(id) one_check(id, "round")))
recheck |> group_by(kind) |> summarise(cells = n(), subgroup_cells = sum(group != "all"), questions = n_distinct(id),
                                       max_valid = max(d_valid), max_asked = max(d_asked), max_mean = max(d_mean), max_n = max(d_n))
stopifnot(sum(recheck$kind == "battery") >= 400, sum(recheck$group != "all") >= 150,
          all(recheck$d_valid <= 0.051 * pmax(1, recheck$k_codes) + 1e-9),
          all(recheck$d_asked <= 0.101 * pmax(1, recheck$k_codes) + 1e-9),
          all(recheck$d_mean < 0.0006), all(recheck$d_n == 0))
```

## Regional lines equal `ab_region()`, including the hybrid time axis

For every battery item (its default share on both bases, or its mean), every country set
and every round the trend view shows (rounds before a declared `start` are not drawn):
the browser's rule (average of the members' published values, only when every member of
a balanced set has one; x at the median fieldwork year of those members, labelled with the
round and the members' year range) applied to the published files must equal
`ab_region()` on `ab_cy_share()` / `ab_cy_mean()` computed from the merge: value,
`n_countries`, `year_mid` and the round label. `pipeline/check_regions.mjs` repeats this
with the site's own JavaScript.

```{r check-regions}
fy <- setNames(cr_ref$year, paste(cr_ref$round, cr_ref$iso3))
nr_key <- paste(all_nr$id, all_nr$round, all_nr$iso3)
region_ref <- list(); reg_cmp <- list()
for (e in index_vars) {
  v <- e$id; ind <- e$d
  rec <- fromJSON(file.path(OUT_DIR, "v", paste0(v, ".json")), simplifyVector = FALSE)
  start <- e$tb$start %||% 1
  hd <- tibble(round = ab$round, iso3 = ab$iso3, country = ab$country, year = ab$year, weight = ab$weight, !!v := ab[[v]])
  for (base in if (ind$type == "mean") "mean" else c("valid", "asked")) {
    cy <- if (base == "mean") ab_cy_mean(hd, v, range = range(hd[[v]][hd[[v]] >= 0]))
          else ab_cy_share(hd, v, unlist(ind$codes), base = base)
    cy <- cy |> filter(!paste(v, round, iso3) %in% nr_key)          # nonresponse-only country-rounds: not published
    for (s in COUNTRY_SETS) {
      ref <- ab_region(cy, value = if (base == "mean") "mean" else "share", countries = s$countries, allow_missing = !s$balanced) |>
        filter(!is.na(value), round >= start)
      site <- bind_rows(tibble(round = integer(), site = double(), n_c = integer(), site_mid = double(), site_label = character()),
        map_dfr(names(rec$est), function(u) {
          if (as.integer(u) < start) return(NULL)
          have <- s$countries[vapply(s$countries, function(c) !is.null(rec$est[[u]][[c]]) && rec$est[[u]][[c]]$nv > 0, logical(1))]
          if (s$balanced && length(have) < length(s$countries)) return(NULL)
          if (!length(have)) return(NULL)
          vals <- vapply(have, function(c) { cell <- rec$est[[u]][[c]]
            if (base == "mean") cell$m else site_share(cell, rec, unlist(ind$codes), base) }, 0)
          yrs <- fy[paste(u, have)]
          tibble(round = as.integer(u), site = mean(vals), n_c = length(have), site_mid = median(yrs),
                 site_label = sprintf("R%s (%s)", u, round_label(yrs)))
        }))
      j <- full_join(ref, site, by = "round")
      k_codes <- if (base == "mean") 0L else length(unlist(ind$codes))
      reg_cmp[[length(reg_cmp) + 1]] <- j |> mutate(var = v, base = base, set = s$id, balanced = s$balanced, k = k_codes)
      region_ref[[length(region_ref) + 1]] <- ref |> mutate(var = v, base = base, set = s$id)
    }
  }
}
reg_cmp <- bind_rows(reg_cmp)
reg_cmp |> group_by(base) |> summarise(points = n(), max_diff = max(abs(value - site)), max_diff_per_code = max(abs(value - site) / pmax(1, k)),
                                       missing = sum(is.na(value) | is.na(site)),
                                       year_mid_ok = all(year_mid == site_mid), label_ok = all(round_label == site_label))
# published shares are rounded to 0.1 per answer code, so a k-code indicator may differ by 0.05k
# (valid base) or 0.1k (asked base, after re-basing), as for the random cells above
reg_cmp <- reg_cmp |> mutate(tol = ifelse(base == "mean", 0.0006, ifelse(base == "valid", 0.051, 0.101) * pmax(1, k)))
stopifnot(!anyNA(reg_cmp$value), !anyNA(reg_cmp$site),
          all(abs(reg_cmp$value - reg_cmp$site) <= reg_cmp$tol),
          all(reg_cmp$n_c == reg_cmp$n_countries), all(reg_cmp$year_mid == reg_cmp$site_mid),
          all(reg_cmp$round_label == reg_cmp$site_label))
# n_countries is constant along every balanced line
stopifnot(all(reg_cmp |> filter(balanced) |> group_by(var, base, set) |> summarise(k = n_distinct(n_countries), .groups = "drop") |> pull(k) == 1))
region_ref <- bind_rows(region_ref)
write.csv(region_ref |> select(var, base, set, round, value, n_countries, year_mid, round_label),
          file.path(REVIEW_DIR, "region_reference.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat(nrow(reg_cmp), "regional points over", length(index_vars), "items and", length(COUNTRY_SETS), "sets\n")
reg_cmp |> filter(var == "dem_support", set == "r3", base == "valid") |> select(round, value, site, n_countries, year_mid, round_label)
```

## Benchmarks: the site's equal-weight means against `AB_merge_audit_benchmarks.csv`

The site's equal-weight country means (base = asked, weight = `weight`), computed from the
published cells exactly as the browser does, must equal the audit's `merged` column to
within 0.05 points (that column is within 0.5 of AB's published figures).

```{r check-benchmarks}
if (all(c(9, 10) %in% UNITS)) {
  bm <- bench |> filter(grepl("weight = weight$", note), !is.na(merged), variable != "", !grepl(" ", variable))
  succ <- c(dem_support = "1", rej_oneman = "4;5", rej_oneparty = "4;5", rej_military = "4;5", dem_satis = "3;4",
            dem_extent = "3;4", demand_dem = "4", supply_dem = "2")
  bm$site <- NA_real_
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(bm))) {
    v <- bm$variable[i]; u <- as.character(bm$round[i])
    rec <- fromJSON(file.path(OUT_DIR, "v", paste0(v, ".json")), simplifyVector = FALSE)
    members <- if (bm$n_countries[i] == 28) set_of$r6$countries else names(rec$est[[u]])
    stopifnot(length(members) == bm$n_countries[i], all(members %in% names(rec$est[[u]])))
    bm$site[i] <- mean(vapply(members, function(c) site_share(rec$est[[u]][[c]], rec, as.numeric(strsplit(succ[[v]], ";")[[1]]), "asked"), 0))
  }
  bm <- bm |> mutate(site_1dp = round(site, 1), diff = site - merged)
  print(bm |> select(round, variable, n_countries, published, merged, site = site_1dp, diff))
  stopifnot(nrow(bm) == 13, all(abs(bm$diff) <= 0.05 + 1e-9))
}
```

## Trend lines never cross a declared break; no R10 statement-item mean

```{r check-breaks}
brk_bad <- character()
for (e in index_vars) {
  if (is.null(e$tb)) next
  pos <- trend_positions(e$u, e$tb)
  rs <- as.integer(names(pos))
  for (i in seq_along(rs)[-1]) {
    crosses <- any(vapply(e$tb$breaks, function(p) rs[i - 1] <= p[1] && p[2] <= rs[i], logical(1)))
    joined <- pos[i] - pos[i - 1] == 1
    if (crosses && joined) brk_bad <- c(brk_bad, paste(e$id, rs[i - 1], rs[i]))
  }
  if (!is.null(e$tb$start) && any(rs < e$tb$start)) brk_bad <- c(brk_bad, paste(e$id, "start"))
}
# segments implied for the brief's list
seg <- function(v) { e <- index_vars[[which(vapply(index_vars, `[[`, "", "id") == v)]]; p <- trend_positions(e$u, e$tb)
  paste(vapply(split(names(p), cumsum(c(1, diff(p) > 1))), function(z) if (length(z) > 1) paste0("R", z[1], "–R", z[length(z)]) else paste0("R", z), ""), collapse = " | ") }
if (identical(UNITS, ROUNDS)) {
  segs <- sapply(c("ab_media_free", "ab_govt_employee", "corr_mps", "voted", "demonstration", "trust_police", "dem_extent"), seg)
  print(segs)
  stopifnot(segs[["ab_media_free"]] == "R3 | R4 | R5–R7 | R8–R10", segs[["ab_govt_employee"]] == "R2–R4 | R5 | R9",
            segs[["corr_mps"]] == "R2 | R3–R10", segs[["voted"]] == "R1 | R3–R4 | R5–R10", segs[["demonstration"]] == "R2–R9 | R10",
            segs[["trust_police"]] == "R3–R10", segs[["dem_extent"]] == "R2–R10")
}
# R10 statement items: no mean anywhere (not offered, and none written)
stmt <- grep("^ab_", names(var_meta), value = TRUE)
m_written <- sum(vapply(stmt, function(v) { rec <- fromJSON(file.path(OUT_DIR, "v", paste0(v, ".json")), simplifyVector = FALSE)
  sum(unlist(lapply(rec$est, function(uu) vapply(uu, function(cell) !is.null(cell$m), logical(1))))) }, 0))
stopifnot(length(brk_bad) == 0, m_written == 0, !any(vapply(index_vars[vapply(index_vars, function(e) grepl("^ab_", e$id), logical(1))], `[[`, TRUE, "m")))
cat("No trend line crosses a declared break;", length(stmt), "statement items carry no means\n")
```

## Payload sizes

```{r sizes}
sizes <- bind_rows(file_sizes)
gz <- function(paths) vapply(paths, function(p) length(memCompress(readBin(p, "raw", file.size(p)), "gzip")), 0)
cat("Total:", nrow(sizes), "files,", round(sum(sizes$bytes) / 1e6, 1), "MB\n")
sizes |> mutate(scope = ifelse(grepl("^R\\d+_", id), "round files", "battery")) |>
  group_by(kind, scope) |> summarise(files = n(), total_MB = round(sum(bytes) / 1e6, 1),
                                     median_KB = round(median(bytes) / 1e3, 1), max_KB = round(max(bytes) / 1e3, 1), .groups = "drop")
big <- sizes |> arrange(desc(bytes)) |> head(8)
big$gz_KB <- round(gz(ifelse(big$kind == "v", file.path(OUT_DIR, "v", paste0(big$id, ".json")),
                             file.path(OUT_DIR, big$kind, big$unit, paste0(big$id, ".json")))) / 1e3, 1)
big
idx_files <- c(file.path(OUT_DIR, "index.json"), file.path(OUT_DIR, "manifest.json"), list.files(file.path(OUT_DIR, "rounds"), full.names = TRUE))
tibble(file = basename(idx_files), KB = round(file.size(idx_files) / 1e3, 1), gz_KB = round(gz(idx_files) / 1e3, 1))
stopifnot(max(big$gz_KB) < 50)
write.csv(sizes, file.path(REVIEW_DIR, "file_sizes.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# Publish

All checks passed, so the staged files replace the site's data.

```{r publish}
for (d in c("v", "g", "r", "rounds")) unlink(file.path(FINAL_DIR, d), recursive = TRUE)
for (d in intersect(c("v", "g", "r", "rounds"), list.files(OUT_DIR)))
  stopifnot(file.rename(file.path(OUT_DIR, d), file.path(FINAL_DIR, d)) || file.copy(file.path(OUT_DIR, d), FINAL_DIR, recursive = TRUE))
for (f in c("manifest.json", "index.json")) file.copy(file.path(OUT_DIR, f), file.path(FINAL_DIR, f), overwrite = TRUE)
cat("Published to", normalizePath(FINAL_DIR), "\n")
```
